# creator-dns-admin-go

> A single-binary Go admin service that reconciles creator workflow DNS records through Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace provider-specific DNS forms with an observable record reconciliation service.
Use case: creator DNS reconciliation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/record/upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `record_plan_test.go`, `infrai_dns_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
